label: OVERLAP_PROFILE_SUM3_FUSION_2: OverlapFusion family u says for every p, Overlap p u iff some x in…
definition: OverlapFusion family u says for every p, Overlap p u iff some x in family overlaps p, using the same existing common-part Overlap. It does not include member containment. UnrestrictedOverlap requires such a witness for every nonempty Lean Set, with the same second-order scope as existing Unrestricted; no empty-family or first-order schema equivalence is asserted.
note: Analyst formulation for #1050; attribution and metaphysical applicability deferred. Common-part overlap is unchanged: an admitted null object would overlap everything. The rival expressly excludes one. See docs/notes/universal-fusion-grounding.md.
